notes.tech: Thread proposed 4 (2026-10-11): Rapha Shadow (Pro Team Shadow jersey, gilet, jacket); Powerweave (bib shorts, shoes); GORE-TEX and GORE-TEX Windstopper (rain jackets, Trail pants, gloves); Polartec (Insulated Windblock Base Layer); PrimaLoft (Lifestyle insulated jacket and vest); OCTA lining (Brevet insulated pieces); bluesign and OEKO-TEX certified fabrics named on PDPs — mixed: GORE-TEX, Windstopper, Polartec, PrimaLoft and OCTA are licensed third-party fabrics; Shadow and Powerweave are Rapha names with no mill stated; share of range 188 of 236 styles synthetic-led (80%); 16 styles name a named technology (Gore-T. Seated as proposed, pending ruling.
notes.craft: Thread proposed 2 (2026-10-11): Rapha owns no making that could be found; its own Impact Report describes a supplier base across 18 countries and names only licensed fabric houses (Gore-Tex, Pertex). Product pages name no maker or mill but carry a country of origin on nearly every style, which is a 2 on the rubric. The tech story is real (Shadow, Powerweave, Gore-Tex) and belongs in tech, not craft. Seated as proposed, pending ruling.

craft_evidence.owned: no: no owned factory found; the 2025 Impact Report speaks only of suppliers across 18 countries; PDP payload countryOfOrigin is VN, PT, CN, ID, RO
craft_evidence.makers: no: no product page names a factory or maker (PDP materials and details read on 234 styles)
craft_evidence.mills: licensed membranes only (GORE-TEX, Polartec, PrimaLoft, OCTA); ISKO denim on the Rapha + Hiut collaboration jeans; no cloth or yarn mill named on regular styles
craft_evidence.madein: 235 of 236 styles carry a countryOfOrigin code in the PDP payload (VN 111, PT 50, CN 48, ID 24, RO 2); the jeans has none; display on the rendered page not checked
craft_evidence.heritage: dated and placed in press (founded 2004, London, by Simon Mottram); the brand about page now redirects to the homepage
craft_evidence.process: partial: PDPs describe fabric weights, membranes and certifications; free crash-repair service; no making process (factory, sewing) documented
craft_evidence.reasoning: Rapha owns no making that could be found; its own Impact Report describes a supplier base across 18 countries and names only licensed fabric houses (Gore-Tex, Pertex). Product pages name no maker or mill but carry a country of origin on nearly every style, which is a 2 on the rubric. The tech story is real (Shadow, Powerweave, Gore-Tex) and belongs in tech, not craft.

ownership.owner: Carpegna Ltd (UK 10898646), controlled by Thomas Layton Walton and Steuart Lawrence Walton (each 25-50%, notified Aug 2017), the Walmart heirs behind RZC Investments; Carpegna holds 75%+ of Rapha Racing Ltd (04849594). No sale since the 2017 deal found; RZC paused new investments in Feb 2026 (Fortune) but still holds the portfolio
